content: DeepSlice 1.2.8 (current, already installed) supports whole-folder batch inference: Model.predict(folderpath, ensemble=True, section_numbers=True) runs all sections in one call. Model.set_bad_sections() excludes damaged sections from angle propagation. Model.propagate_angles() averages predicted cutting angle across all sections in the folder (since sections from the same block share one angle) -- this directly reduces the v1.0 'manual angle review per section' burden to a single shared-angle pass for the 5-section wBA1-3 series. Model.enforce_index_spacing(section_thickness=...) reorders/regularizes AP placement using known section thickness.
